info.title: Wan image editing
info.description: Ali Wan image editing capability documentation. The unified API endpoint is `/v1/images/edits`. This document describes the public gateway contract for `wan2.7-image-pro`: `input.messages[].content[]` carries images and text instructions, while other control fields use top-level OpenAI-style fields that the gateway maps to upstream `parameters`.

post.description:
Calls Ali `wan2.7-image-pro` to perform image editing.

The public calling convention keeps top-level `model`, `input`, `response_format`, and exposes `size`, `n`, `watermark`, `negative_prompt`, `seed`, `bbox_list` as top-level fields. Input images are placed in `input.messages[0].content[].image`, and the editing instruction is in a `text` item within the same array. The request body does not accept a top-level `parameters` field.

content.text: Spray the graffiti from image 2 onto the car in image 1
Place the alarm clock from image 1 at the selected area in image 2

200.description: Success. Returns the image editing result.

401.description: Authentication failed, e.g. missing or invalid token.

429.description: Rate limit triggered or insufficient account quota.

500.description: Internal server error while processing the request.

502.description: Upstream provider returned an abnormal response.

503.description: Upstream provider is temporarily unavailable, or no available channel for the current model.

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

size.description: Controls output image resolution. For image editing, supports `1K` (default) or `2K`. The gateway maps this to upstream `parameters.size`.

n.description: Number of images to generate. Important: `n` directly affects cost. Cost = unit price × number of successfully generated images. Confirm the model pricing before calling. The gateway maps this to upstream `parameters.n`.

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark. The watermark is positioned at the bottom-right corner with the text 'AI生成'. `false` (default): no watermark. `true`: add watermark. The gateway maps this to upstream `parameters.watermark`.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt. Describes what should be avoided in the output. The gateway maps this to upstream `parameters.negative_prompt`.

seed.description: Random seed. Range [0, 2147483647]. Using the same seed helps keep generation results relatively stable. Note: the generation process is probabilistic; the same seed does not guarantee identical results every time. The gateway maps this to upstream `parameters.seed`.

bbox_list.description: Interactive editing bounding box regions, corresponding to input images in order. Each element is an array of bounding boxes `[x1, y1, x2, y2]` for that image. Empty array `[]` means no selection for that image. The gateway maps this to upstream `parameters.bbox_list`.

messages.description: Currently only single-turn messages are supported.

content.description: The content array contains image objects and text instruction objects in order.

image.description: Input image URL or Data URL. Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP.

text.description: Editing instruction. Supports Chinese and English, up to 5000 characters. Excess characters will be automatically truncated.

size.description: Controls output image resolution. For image editing, supports `1K` (default) or `2K`.

n.description: Number of images to generate. Important: `n` directly affects cost. Cost = unit price × number of successfully generated images. Confirm the model pricing before calling.

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark. The watermark is positioned at the bottom-right corner with the text 'AI生成'. `false` (default): no watermark. `true`: add watermark.

metadata.description: Pass-through raw response metadata from the upstream provider.

url.description: Used when the result is returned as a URL.

b64_json.description: Used when the result is returned as Base64.

revised_prompt.description: Revised prompt returned by the upstream provider.

type.description: Error type, e.g. `invalid_request_error`, `api_error`, or an upstream-compatible error type.
